reasoning: On the season so far the Magic are the stronger team; with home court the Magic start about 11 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bucks (streak).
Bottom line: the Magic win 76 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 198 and 247 total points.
